title: Record physical observation provenance
description: Record operator-entered physical observations with complete provenance, sample identity, exact assumptions, units, raw values, and diagnostics while explicitly retaining an unvalidated status.
acceptanceCriteria: Physical-provenance records require operator entry source, stable sample identity, exact setup/loading/configuration/layout assumptions, units, and raw values
Validation rejects missing provenance, duplicate sample identity, non-finite values, unsupported units, and assumption mismatches
Stored diagnostics distinguish entry validity from evidence sufficiency or physical suitability
Saving an observation never marks it validated and never creates or updates a usable profile

steps.details: Add a versioned physical provenance variant with required source, sample, assumption, unit, raw-value, diagnostic, and unvalidated-status fields.
Normalize allowed units and return field-associated reasons for incomplete, duplicate, malformed, non-finite, or mismatched input.
Store accepted records locally without deriving correction, confidence, suitability, or profile state.
Cover complete records, every required field, sample uniqueness, layout binding, round trip, and absence of profile side effects.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; add the record contract, validator, and repository round-trip only.
Operator-entered physical provenance records what was reported; it does not prove validity or suitability.
